notes: Adds owner-controlled in-app notifications for meaningful Atlas events and follow-ups.
Notification records are business-isolated, deduplicated, auditable and derived only from authoritative Atlas records.
Preferences cover Today Focus, Outcome follow-up and Weekly Review reminders with safe defaults.
Read/unread state and deep-link targets are persisted; delivery does not imply action completion or outcome causation.
Mobile Notification Center supports unread state, mark-read/read-all, pull-to-refresh, safe deep links, preference controls and explicit external-delivery boundaries.
No external push, SMS, email provider, paid service, production credential or production delivery is activated in VS-11.
PES framework, tab structure, authentication and state-management conventions remain unchanged.
Runtime remains disabled outside development/test; release, deployment and production enablement are not authorized.

approvals.rationale: Product Owner instructed starting VS-11 after certified VS-10 merge.
VS-11 implementation completed and CI #168, Security baseline #157 and Product intake #142 passed on the exact implementation head.
Product Owner instructed proceeding to the next close-out step after all VS-11 implementation gates passed.
